data_spans.description: Preserved the original arrow cursor bitmap, cursor mask, hotspot, and gray patterns.

edits.description: Retained NewHandle through SetStdProcs in source order, including the original CURDATA definitions. Preserved applicable comments and the original filename, copyright notice, and GRAFASM.TEXT heading.
Removed the hasPenFraction block in InitPort. The source history dates the addition to May 1990. The Mac Plus ROM has no corresponding store.
Expanded UNLINK for its four-byte parameter using the original macro instructions. The expansion emits UNLK, the parameter removal, and RTS.
Made the short BNE branch and PC addressing explicit. These spellings reproduce the ROM encoding.

Copied required global, field, color, and trap-table equates. Set lastGrafGlob to -202 and xToolTable to $C00, as the ROM requires. Defined the original trap opcodes and the verified external routine addresses.
Removed later archive annotations from the InitPort fall-through and omitted placeholder header fields. Added marked reconstruction notes.

verification.method: Called Reconstruction/Tools/verify.py verify_module in an independent temporary directory. The verifier translated the MPW source, assembled for MC68000, linked at the ROM address, checked entry points and relocations, and compared every emitted byte.
verification.scope: The entire emitted span, including its original data, matches the ROM. MPW assembly has not been run. GrafInit.a is a reconstruction filename.
